evidence.claim: FDA revoked authorization for FD&C Red No. 3 on January 15, 2025; food and dietary-supplement manufacturers have until January 15, 2027 to reformulate, while ingested drugs have until January 18, 2028.
FDA later encouraged food manufacturers to accelerate phase-out of FD&C Red No. 3 before the January 15, 2027 deadline.

node: Natural colors, flavors, extracts, and clean-label reformulation inputs
summary: Layer 1B expands the node around upstream reformulation suppliers rather than packaged-food brands. The clearest direct exposure is Sensient, whose Color Group and natural-color positioning map tightly to the FDA Red No. 3 reformulation deadline. IFF is included only as a larger reference anchor because it has natural colors/flavors capabilities but the exposure is diluted. The underfollowed lane adds Balchem and Hawkins as second-order chokepoint candidates: microencapsulation, flavor protection, custom blending, specialty ingredient distribution, and application support could matter when brands need stable natural-color or clean-label substitutes. These are research candidates, not recommendations; several mappings remain hypotheses requiring segment revenue and customer-use verification.
